title: Plain Tote Bag Canvas Flat type Direct Supplier (High Quality)
description:
Plain Tote Bag Canvas Flat type Direct Supplier (High Quality)

Plain Canvas Flat Tote Bag

sizes by inches:
*9x10
*10x12
*12x14
*13x15
*14x16

*Good quality
*Eco friendly
*Good for souvenirs(Wedding, Birthday, Debut, Giveaway, Celebration)

Choose size on variation

Read

-We also do customize sizes

-Also available with print with min. order at least 20 pcs

-Some products are onhand and readily available, pick up/ ship out in 2-3 days once available.

-Cod is only available on selected location. Shopee has the overall control of the shipment not us.

-Shipping lead time of Shopee is 3-10 days.

-Please leave us a feedback once you are satisfied

Don't hesitate to contact with us for inquiries/questions

DIRECT MESSAGE/EMAIL FOR BULK ORDER'S
